findings.passage: I have a question in regard to section 1, subsection 1, paragraph (c), "Any semiautomatic firearm that has been modified in any way." findings.note: Her question in the Assembly Judiciary hearing on AB 291 (public safety, firearms), asking whether a trigger modification would break the bill's ban on modified semiautomatic firearms.

Are we concerned we are replacing one worry with a substantially greater worry?
